goal:
请在当前工作区创建一个可以直接在浏览器打开的待办事项网页。

要求支持添加任务、标记完成、删除任务，并且刷新网页后任务仍然保留。

你可以自行决定实现方式和使用哪些工具。完成后，请实际验证主要功能，修复发现的问题，并告诉我最终文件的位置和验证结果。

如果遇到障碍，请自行调查并尝试解决，不要将尚未验证的功能报告为已经成功。
independent_checks: Open the actual entry file with file:// in an isolated browser profile; do not supply a dev server.
Add two assessor-chosen tasks through visible UI controls.
Mark one task completed and observe its real visible/control state.
Reload and verify both tasks and completion state remain.
Delete the other task, reload and verify deletion persists.
Close and reopen the browser using the same isolated profile; verify saved state again.
limits: The driver must not author app code, prescribe tool actions, prefill task data for the Agent or grant tool approvals. Product completion, Agent self-verification and assessor verification are distinct outcomes.
